subject: Renewal QBR: workshop slot negotiation and procurement handoff
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@clearmindhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearmindhealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR workshop — availability constraints and draft prework

Hi Jonas,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're prioritizing the Renewal QBR and roadmap workshop, but our execs' calendars have tightened — they asked to avoid multi-day half-day windows.

We wanted to propose two options and get your recommendation:
- Option A: two 90-minute sessions (Product team + Exec summary) on June 10 and June 12 (noon–1:30pm PT)
- Option B: single focused 2-hour session (June 11, 10:00–12:00 PT) with condensed agenda (exec + product + procurement 60/60 split)

Procurement flag: we need a completed SOW and a PO by June 21 to meet our internal renewal cutover. I attached our QBR prework and a PO template from finance for your review. Can you confirm which option works best for Redwood and whether we should loop in someone from your procurement/finance team? Also, please confirm the playbook items you’ll cover during the product portion — we want to make sure the exec time is high-signal.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Gomez
VP, Strategy | ClearMind Health

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the prework.

Quick responses:
- Both options are workable from our side. My recommended default is Option B (single 2-hour session) if you want fewer calendar fragments — we can compress product updates to a 50–60 minute technical walk and reserve 45–60 minutes for the exec discussion and procurement next steps.
- Procurement: looping in Priyom (CC'd) — he can manage the SOW / PO handoff and confirm DocuSign routing. Priyom, do you need anything else from ClearMind to hit the June 21 PO deadline?

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm preferred date/time (June 11 10:00–12:00 PT) by EOD Friday so we can lock calendars.
2) I’ll send a concise 2‑page meeting runbook and a short list of product artifacts (latency/cost baseline + targeted roadmap upgrades) for exec review.
3) Priyom will open the procurement thread and prepare an initial SOW + DocuSign draft.

If you prefer the split sessions, we can land the exec slot first and schedule the deeper product workshop the following day.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks, Option B works better for our execs. Please lock June 11 10:00–12:00 PT. A few procurement clarifications so Priyom can get moving:
- We will generate the PO once the SOW has the final pricing line and the Legal-approved terms.
- Finance requires a PO number on the DocuSign envelope; we can create that after the SOW is signed but need the SOW returned to us for internal routing by June 17 to make the June 21 PO date.

I've attached our PO template for reference; procurement@ will take care of issuing the PO once SOW is signed. For the meeting runbook, can Redwood cover:
- Current average p99 latency across our primary workloads (2–3 slides)
- Recent cost savings from batching/cache changes and projected delta for '22–'23 workloads
- Recommended rollout plan (canary -> full) and fallback policies in case of regressions

We will have our Head of Platform and Head of Procurement on the call.

Thanks — Elena
